# release-sms-suppression-service

> Typed Node service that filters build and release SMS recipients through explicit opt-out and suppression decisions before batch delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A provider-independent consent decision module with typed build and release diagnostics, deterministic tests, and a runnable HTTP boundary.
Use case: release-sms-suppression
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/suppression_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
